about: One row per moment a perk can react to. Each row generates one TriggerDef; 'source' names the hooks.json row that detects it. Every trigger works for either team (perks can belong to the player or to an opponent team).

columns.stages: effect stages allowed after this trigger: now; cross = when the ball crosses the net; enemy_touch = first touch by the other team after it crossed
columns.conds: condition keys that make sense here
columns.verified: how it was seen firing in the running game, or 'no'

rows.meaning: a spike by the owner team that the game accepted
a spin or float serve by the owner team
a tip by the owner team that the game accepted
any accepted set or bump by the owner team
an accepted set by the owner team's setter
an accepted bump of an incoming ball faster than 60 (receiving an attack)
a strong block by the owner team (the game's big-block branch)
a normal jump by the owner team
a block jump by the owner team
the start of every match (effects last the whole match)
the owner team reaches n accepted touches in a row without losing a rally (the count restarts after firing)
the other team wins n rallies in a row
the owner team wins n rallies in a row (fires once, on the n-th)
rows.verified: in game 2026-10-09: '[trace] P Momentum <- win_streak' on the first rally won

rows.meaning: the current rally reaches n accepted touches by both teams together (fires once per rally, for each team that has the perk)
a rally starts with the other team one point from winning the match
the other team makes an accepted spike (defensive reactions; ball effects act on their incoming spike)
